skill.summary: Transforms any text into five SEO-optimized, tone-adapted versions with improved readability, grammar, and social media snippets for better engagement.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Content Rewriter Pro.

- Instantly rewrites any text while keeping the original meaning.
- Automatically optimizes content for SEO keywords and readability.
- Offers multiple tone options: professional, casual, viral, sales, and technical.
- Generates five content variations for A/B testing and social snippets.
- Built-in SEO tools: keyword density checks, meta descriptions, title suggestions, and more.
